purpose: Fix assessment criteria before seeing new model outputs. This is an editorial checklist, not an automatic quality score.
historical_provenance: Saved final outputs have multiple generation and repair passes from older models. Exact authorship cannot be assigned from the most recent log row alone. Historical generation logs are copied beside each baseline.
